dvor-ineya/government/lunnaya-tsaritsa.h.title: Lunnaya Tsaritsa
dvor-ineya/government/lunnaya-tsaritsa.h.description:
While the current Lunnaya Tsaritsa's reign began shortly after the enlightenment, the title itself can refer to any of its previous holders throughout history. The Lunnaya Tsaritsa's role is not only that of governance, acting as an envoy of the Lady of Dormition in the material plane. Considered the highest authority in the land, she presides over the three governing bodies, resolving any disputes among them.Tsaritsy of note:
Morana, the first Lunnaya Tsaritsa TBD (Feofan era) Current tsaritsa

dvor-ineya/history/morana.html.title: Morana
dvor-ineya/history/morana.html.description: The first envoy of the Lady of Dormition--and consequently first Lunnaya Tsaritsa--who brought order to the warring and chaotic factions of Unseelie Fey who existed in ancient times.

dvor-ineya/oblasts/kholodhnograd-(oblast.title: Kholodhnograd (Oblast)
dvor-ineya/oblasts/kholodhnograd-(oblast.description: The most significant province of Dvor Ineya. It derives its name from the nation's capital city, Kholodhnograd (City).

dvor-ineya/oblasts/morskaya-gavan.html.title: Morskaya Gavan
dvor-ineya/oblasts/morskaya-gavan.html.description: The primary region of commerce and global relations. Its provincial capital, Zmei, serves as one of the few large-scale ports that accommodates international travel in all of Dvor Ineya.

dvor-ineya/dvor-ineya,-the-unseelie-cour.title: Dvor Ineya, the Unseelie Court of Frost
dvor-ineya/dvor-ineya,-the-unseelie-cour.description:
Dvor Ineya--also known as the Court of Frost--is the homeland of most Unseelie Fey in the Material Plane. Governed by the Lunnaya Tsaritsa, it is a frigid and mountainous island nation located in the northern reaches of Alteres.While the outer reaches of the nation are more level, the inner regions are highly mountainous, requiring specialized infrastructure to settle.
Divided into X Oblasts or provinces, Dvor Ineya Special Mountain? --> curse
Headed by the Lunnaya Tsaritsa herself, the governing system is divided into 3 branches. The Ecclesiarchy representing religious interests, The Ledyanoy Veche representing the peoples voices in legislative matters, and The High Court of Morana representing the primary judicial authority. The leaders of these branches often have conflicts due to differing interests of the parties they represent, but the Tsaritsa is able to bring balance and resolve these disputes. In addition, each Oblast is represented by a Vestnik Zimy. The Vestniki Zimy act as instruments of the Tsaritsa's will throughout the land, rooting out treason and corruption.
The only deity actively worshipped in Dvor Ineya is the Lady of Dormition,
represented by the Church of Repose and the Lunnaya Tsaritsa herself.Calamity?

info_showOrphanNodes.description: Show nodes that are not connected to any other nodes.

info_showAttachments.description: Show attachments like images and PDFs as nodes in the graph.

info_allowGlobalGraph.description: Allow the user to view the global graph of all nodes.

info_allowExpand.description: Allow the user to pop-out the graph view to take up the whole screen

info_attractionForce.description: How much should linked nodes attract each other? This will make the graph appear more clustered.

info_linkLength.description: How long should the links between nodes be? The shorter the links the more connected nodes will cluster together.

info_repulsionForce.description: How much should nodes repel each other? This will make disconnected parts more spread out.

info_centralForce.description: How much should nodes be attracted to the center? This will make the graph appear more dense and circular.

info_edgePruning.description: Edges with a length above this threshold will not be rendered, however they will still contribute to the simulation. This can help large tangled graphs look more organised. Hovering over a node will still display these links.

info_minNodeRadius.description: How small should the smallest nodes be? The smaller a node is the less it will attract other nodes.

info_maxNodeRadius.description: How large should the largest nodes be? Nodes are sized by how many links they have. The larger a node is the more it will attract other nodes. This can be used to create a good grouping around the most important nodes.
